content: No – it was unfair to young people. The new AHV pension increase is funded primarily by current workers’ contributions, most of whom are younger and still building their careers; those workers will receive the benefit only after decades, while the immediate beneficiaries are today’s retirees. This creates a disproportionate burden on the current younger generation and undermines inter‑generational equity.
